notes:
Hey! I’m excited to share a new update for Stamply, an app that turns your photos into collectible stamp-like pieces. You can now tap a stamp to reveal its metadata and even edit details like date and location. Comment below if you love it!

Designer: @tweetbylokki. Curated on Collect UI (https://collectui.com).
